tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// snar thang brgya rtsa las 'byung ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// sa gsum skye dgu'i khengs pa ring btang nas// bslu med skyabs su bsten pa dkon mchog gsum// ma lus 'dus pa'i bdag nyid sdom brtson tshul// chos mchog 'doms pa bla mas dge legs stsol// 'od mtha' yas pa'i gzugs sku'i 'od zer stong*// skal dman lus phra'i 'dren byed ma 'tsham par// gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul byed pos bdar ba'i nyi// rgyal bstan nam mkha'i rgyan gyur a ti sha// gang gi thugs rje rmad byung dpyid dus kyi// dpal las rim par 'phos pa lhag pa'i lha// sna tshogs sgrub thabs man ngag rjes su gnang*// yid ches sum ldan u dum+bā ra'i tshal// de las zab chos me tog chig brgya phrag /tshogs gsum srad bur tshar du dngar ba'i phreng*// sprul 'tshong 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal ngom phyir min// mang thos legs bris gzhon nu dga' ba'i rgyan// tshul de las byung mngon rtogs rjes su gnang*// rnam gzhag spyi las 'phros pa'i khyad par chos// ma 'dres gsal ba'i cho ga rang nyid dang*// skal mnyam ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo phyir bskrun// de'ang 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgyal ba'i sras chen dpal ldan a ti sha nyid/ rje btsun sgrol mas lung bstan pa ltar/ bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs 'dir skal ba dam pa'i shing rtas nye bar spyan drangs/ lha chos bdun ldan gyi bstan pa'i srol btod pa sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i sgo 'phar dpag tu med pa phye bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i nang nas 'dir gang gi zhal sgo nas nye bar brgyud pa'i yi dam gyi lha'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang gdams ngag thor bu ba rnams snar thang gi mkhan po nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pas snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos las/

lha so so'i mngon par rtogs pa rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i rgyun bzhugs pa rnams lag tu blang bde bar bkar te phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa la/ thog mar bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu la ras sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng*/ maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su 'bras kyi tshom bu dgod/ mdun phyogs dbang ldan nas me'i bar du yi dam chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma zlum gtor gsum dang*/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ rang gi mdun du bum pa gnyis nang rdzas mgul chings kha rgyan dang ldan pa'i khar/ mchod yon gyi dung phor gzungs rdor dang bcas pa bsham/ gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu me tog gi snod sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ gnyis pa slob dpon gyi bya ba mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsar+b+ba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghṃ swā hā nas shab+da swā hā'i bar dang dhar+m+ma ra ṇi rol mo bcas pas byin dbab/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi ltar sngon du song nas/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ ser po/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor mngon par 'phags shing*/ mtshan bzang po so gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig tshon can gsum gsol ba/ 'od zer gyi phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus na zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i

gnas gsum byin rlabs ma ṇi ba'i yi ger 'dir byung yang mchims dang skyid shod pa'i yi ger 'og tu 'byung ba btsan pa'i dbang du byas/ thugs kar ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar ser/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa gong bzhin spyan drangs la mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas/ thun mtshams su bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/

zhes 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ nyer bsdu ni/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang nā da'i bar du thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par gzhag de las ldang ba na slar yang skad cig gis lha'i skur gyur par bsam/ bdag bskyed tsam nyams su len na 'di'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /thub pa'i dbang po 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyis bsngo ba dang smon lam brjod pas grub bo// rjes gnang dang 'brel ba la/ bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad dang ldan pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma sogs nas/ de'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar ser zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ shākya thub pa dang bgegs mthar byed spyan drangs la bstim pa dang*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa dang dbang bskur ba rnams gong dang 'dra ba las spyi gtsug tu lud pa las thub pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ bgegs mthar byed la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ bgegs mthar byed la 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs kyis bstod la/

rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha'i rgyud bskul ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la rnam rgyal la lha sngags brgya rtsa dang*/ las bum la oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta ces pa'ang oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas na legs par mngon ci rigs bzlas la/ 'dod don zhus mthar yig brgyas kha bskangs la/ las bum kha brgyan gyis chu 'thor ba dang bcas te/ ji srid rjes su gnang ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu'i rnam par gyur/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma sogs nas rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs pa bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar shākya thub par bskyed de mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re res thog drangs pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs par byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas gtor ma dang po bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lha'i sngags la i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa bstan bsrung dam tshig can rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/

oṃ shrī dharma pā lā ya sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ bstan srung dam tshig can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las dang 'gro don thams cad rtag tu rgyas pa'i phrin las stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gtor ma gsum pa'ang byin gyis brlabs nas/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling spyi dang bye brag ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i sa bdag gzhi bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas bkug na maḥsar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis bsngos/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di sa bdag gzhi bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor thams cad spangs nas/ ji ltar bsams pa'i don thams cad gegs med du 'grub pa'i stong grogs dam pa mdzod cig ces dang*/ sar+b+ba bhū mī pa ti gats+tshas rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang 'khor ba las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i snang byed du gyur pa/

sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa jo bo chen po rje a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i yi dam lha'i mngon par rtogs pa rjes gnang man ngag thor bur bzhugs pa rnams snar thang gi mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par brten/ snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos chen po las byung ba'i yi dam gyi lha khyad par can rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de la'ang dang por bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i rjes gnang sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi// chu srin la sogs 'jigs rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/ sdom pa gzung ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi rnam pa can ma yin par dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i zhing khams yin snyam pa dang*/ bla ma yang lhag pa'i lha dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal 'di yang bsgrubs zin pa ltar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sogs nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar brjod pas ngo sprad/

de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang mtha' skor du yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs sprin ltar gtibs nas bzhugs par mos te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas sdom pa phog nas/ dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi rdo rje slob dpon gyis// bdag la thub pa chen po yi// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ gsol gdab 'di sku gsung thugs so sor mi thub pa ltar na/ skabs 'dir gsum char bsdoms te/ de'ang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces brda sprad la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje gsum bdag slob dpon gyis// bdag la thub pa chen po yi// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// zhes brjod pas btub ste bla ma'i phyag len la'ang de ltar mchis/ mchims sogs mkhas pa'i yig cha 'ga' zhig tu 'dir gsol gdab bya ba ma bshad pa'ang yod pa'i phyir ro// de nas slob ma las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was slob ma'i phung khams skye mched stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gong ltar thub pa chen po thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar ser gyi bar gyis bskyed/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa gsal btab/ slob dpon thub pa chen por gsal ba la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de dag thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad thub pa chen po'i sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba nyungs 'bru tsam gyi bar bgrang du med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te steng nas byon pa rnams kha ba bu yug 'tshub pa lta bu/

'og nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyis rlangs rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba lta bur byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas mtsho chen po la kha babs pa ltar sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ spro na dril gsil dang bcas/ ma lus sems can zhes pa nas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ mu ni sogs la/ badz+ra ā be sha ya a a/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmang du brjod pas bstim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dang bum chu spyi bor gtor la 'thung du gzhug ces dbang bskur bar sku'i byin rlabs thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lha'i sku 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da dril gsil bar bya/ zhes pas mchod pa dang bcas pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngar gyi gsol ba 'debs par gsung gi zhes 'don pa bsgyur la gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/

thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod ces dang oṃ mu ni sogs kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog de dag sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa dang*/ brtul bzhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// de brtan pa'i ched du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas gsung gi byin rlabs thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lha'i gsung 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la gong bzhin mchod pa dang bcas pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs par thugs zhes 'don pa bsgyur la gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de dag thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thub pa chen po'i sku'am thugs phyag mtshan/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/

snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la thim/ de'ang 'od phung du zhu nas snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar yal te gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis zab gsal gnyis su med pa lhag pa lha'i skur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de brtan pa'i ched du dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lha'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes grub pa'i bag chags gzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pas rdo rje'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la gong ltar mchod pa dang bcas pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ste/ spro na/ de dag brtan pa'i yan lag tu dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ zhes khas blangs nas rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyi bzhes nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ des bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ rjes mchod pa kha gsos te tshom bu la mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/

oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam mo// rjes gnang mang po sbrel nas byed na/ las kyi rdo rje lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu dang mchod pa rnying pa bsdus nas gsar pa bsham/ yi dam gyi gtor ma kha gso/ de'i bar la slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ lha so so'i bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa/ slob ma la bya ba bcas pa'i spyi chings thams cad gong ltar las/ lha'i gdan dang sa bon dang*/ gtso 'khor du yod kyi mngon rtogs dang*/ rigs bdag dang*/ sngags dang mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams so sor sbyor tshul ma 'dres par shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// chos thun re re zhing yang rjes gnang dang po la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gsol gdab so sor bya zhing*/ phyi ma rnams la bsdoms te gsol ba gdab pa ma gtogs gzhan thams cad gong bzhin mdzad pa'i phyag len yang mchis mod/ maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi spos kyi byug cing sogs dang*/ thun mong gi gsol gdab dang rgyun bshags lan re byas pas chog go /'di nas brtsams te lha so so'i mngon rtogs kyi khyad par rnams brjod do// de'ang gnas brtan bcu drug ni/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi lte bar rang nyid sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog sogs nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod pas gsal gdab/ 'dab ma bcu drug gi shar gyi 'dab ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin du gnas brtan chen po sgra gcan 'dzin phyag na rin po che'i prog zhu bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam phran brtan phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/

gnas brtan chen po bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po lam brten phyag g.yas na glegs bam/ g.yon chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'o// lho'i 'dab ma bzhi la rim pa bzhin du gnas brtan chen po klu'i sde pa phyag g.yas bum pa/ g.yon 'khar gsil bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po sbed byed phyag na glegs bam bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po mi phyed pa phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byang chub chen po'i mchod rten bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po yan lag 'byung phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na spos phor bsnams shing mchan khung g.yon na rnga yab bsnams pa'o// nub kyi 'dab ma bzhi la gnas brtan chen po ma pham pa phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po nags na gnas phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po dus ldan phyag na gser gyi rna kor bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po rdo rje mo'i bu phyag g.yas zhi ba'i sdigs mdzub mdzad cing*/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa'o// byang gi 'dab ma bzhi la gnas brtan chen po bzang po phyag g.yas chos 'chad/ g.yon mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po gser be'u phyag na rin po che'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ gnas brtan chen po bā ra dh+wa dza gser can phyag gnyis mnyam par gzhag pa/ gnas brtan chen po ba ku la phyag na ne'u le bsnams pa'o// sgo bzhi'i shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor spyan mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ shar du dge bsnyen chen po dharma tā phyag na rnga yab dang bum pa bsnams pa/ ral pa thod du bcings shing sde snod gsum gyi glegs bam khur ba/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs pa/

dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol zhing pus mo brdzes pa/ pus mo g.yas pa las stag gi tshogs sprul pa/ dge bsnyen gyi tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dgra bcom pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bzhugs par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ston pa bde bar gshegs pa gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ lag mthil ltar mnyam rin chen rgyan gyis spras// ljon shing chu mtshos brgyan pa'i sa gzhi'i dbus// rin chen las grub gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa// pad+ma nyi zlas brgyan pa'i gdan steng du// thugs rjes rtsod pa'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams// rnam grol lam du 'god mdzad 'gro ba'i mgon// thub pa mchog dang gnas brtan chen po rnams// 'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod cing spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags ni oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ zhes bzla/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shākya mu ni sa pa ri wā ra sbyar/ bstod pa ni/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan sogs nas dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas sprul pa dgra bcom 'phags pa'i tshogs// 'gro ba'i don du bstan pa skyong mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum dngos gnas brtan bcu drug la// sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal lo// de nyid la gsol gdab kyi tshe/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi/ bstan pa yun ring gnas par byin gyis rlobs zhes bsgyur ro// ༈ /mi 'khrugs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang

'di dang 'og gi thugs rje chen po dang*/ bcu gcig zhal dang*/ sgrol ma ljang gu dang dzam+bha la ser po ste lnga po bskyed gzhi snying gar zla gdan sogs kyi steng du skyed pa ni bdag bskyed dang slob ma lha bskyed kyi skabs su 'di ltar byed pa gzhung gis dngos bstan yin/ de lta na'ang mdun bskyed dang slob ma dang bum nang lha bskyed pa'i tshe stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'am ram̐ las nyi ma sogs skabs gang bab dang sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas zhes bsgyur te bskyed pa ma gtogs rang gi lus sbyor ba'i dmigs pa dor ba sogs rnam dbye shes par bya'o// 'on kyang 'dir stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma sogs gong 'og gzhan rnams kyi rigs 'gres sbyar ba ni yig cha gzhan thams cad du'ang de ltar 'byung ba ltar dang phyag len bde ba'i ched du sor gzhag byas pa yin pas gang mos byar rung ngo*// gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus rnam smin sha khrag rdos bcas kyi phung po dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bcas pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i spyan gnyis 'gro la gzigs shing dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ na bza' chos gos dmar po sogs tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/

sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwā nāñtsa swā hā zhes thugs ka'i sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul lam zhal nas 'thon te lte ba nas zhugs shing mgal me 'khor ba ltar dmigs nas bzla/ mtshan sngags oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya/ bstod pa ni/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur len pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// ༈ /thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog gangs kyi ri bo ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mtshon pa'i pad+ma dkar po rgyas pa dang 'bras bu yod pa dang kha 'bus pa gsum rtsa ba gcig las gyes pa bsnams pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang ldan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po sogs nas snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes bzla/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa ni/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhes sogs kyis bstod// ༈ /spyan ras gzigs seng ge sgra ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po/ de'i steng du a las seng ge dkar mo/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rje btsun seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/

phyag g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga phral te pus mo g.yas krong nge ba'i steng na kha sbub cing g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan spangs shing sku skem pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'gying bag gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi zhags mig nas pad+ma'i lcug ma skyes te gnyis su gyes pa'i ring ba shos kyi pad+ma la ral gri 'bar ba dang*/ nye ba'i pad+ma'i steng na me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs pas bkang ba'i thod pa dkar po gnas pa/ g.yas logs kyi sku'i thad kar ma reg pa'i tri shū la ljang gu la sbrul dkar po kha nas khrag 'dzag pas dkris te kha tshur lta ba/ ras kyi skud pa nyis sgril mdud pa can dpung pa g.yas kyi 'og nas g.yon steng du dkris pa'i tshangs skud dang ldan pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hrīḥdakar po zhes pa nas snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsingha nā da hūm̐ zhes bzla/ singha nā da/ bstod pa ni/ dri med chu skyes lte bar gdong lnga'i steng*// rol pa'i stabs bzhugs zhi 'dzum thugs rje'i gter// 'gro ba'i nad gdon sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa// 'phags mchog seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// ༈ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar po zhal bcu gcig gi rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dmar/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum dbus ljang*/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ de'i steng gi zhal gsum dbus dmar/ g.yas ljang*/ g.yon dkar pa/ de'i steng na khro zhal nag po mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du 'greng ba/

de'i spyi bor zhi ba'i zhal dmar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing rgyan spangs pa/ mgul pa yan chad phyung ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pa bgrang phreng*/ gsum pas yi dwags kyi bkres skom sel ba/ bzhi pas 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis pas gser gyi pad+ma yu ba dang bcas pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs/ bzhi pas mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa gnyis pos mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad kyi mthil du spyan re re yod pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung ngam mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ ras bzang pos sku smad g.yogs shing*/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa dmar ser 'khrugs pas mdzes pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po phyag len mi mdzad kyang ye shes pa spyan drangs par mchod nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa la bdag skyabs su mchi'o// ma rnams kyi don du skyabs su mchi'o// snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod nas dgug gzhug bya bar bshad/ sogs nas/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya dzñā na sā ga ra bai ro tsa na byū ha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yaḥ ar+ha te bh+yaḥ samyak+saṃ bud+dha bh+yaḥ na maḥ.ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ iṭ+ṭe waṭ+ṭe/ tsa le tsa le/ pra tsa le pra tsa le/ ku su me ku su ma wa re i li mi li/ tsi ti dz+wa la ma pa na ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bstod pa/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// zhes sogs bya//

༈ /seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tāṃ yig ljang gu de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog mar gad ltar ljang zhing dri ma med pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon ut+pa la'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ ral pa phyed thor cog tu byas shing phyed cung zad 'phyang ba/ lang tsho dar la bab cing sku sha shin tu rgyas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dar gyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ ljang gu sogs nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya tā re/ bstod pa/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhes sogs so// ༈ /sgrol ma dkar mo tshe 'phel ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pas pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa bsnams shing*/ g.yon mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i lang tsho rgyas pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa/ nag cing snum pa'i ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma sil bur grol bas sku stod khebs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ bzlas pa ni/ rang gi thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/

de'i lte bar tām̐ dang oṃ dang hā'i bar du ma ma ā yuḥpuṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru zhes dang*/ rtsibs brgyad la tā re la sogs pa yi ge brgyad bkod pa la dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re bdag gi tshe 'phel bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa bya'o// mtshan sngags/ ār+ya tā re/ bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// zhes sogs kyis bstod// ༈ /lha mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dkar po/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid paṃ gser gyi kha dog lta bu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas lha mor gyur/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje paṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo ri khrod lo ma gyon ma/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa ni dgra s+t+wa gsum pa na mda' bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gnyis pa ni shing lo'i chun po/ gsum pa na gzhu bsnams pa/ me tog dmar pos thod bcings pa'i ral pa'i thor cog can/ shing lo gshibs pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sku skem zhing sgeg pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas bgegs kyi rgyal po'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du paṃ ser po sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa sha wa ri sarba ro ga pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ par+ṇa sha wa ri/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun du zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ /'od zer can ma ni/

stong pa'i ngang las seng ge'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du oṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ na bza' chos gos dmar po gsol zhing tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ shing mya ngan med pa'i sdong po la sku rgyab brten pa/ de'i 'od kyis rang gi gnas sa 'gro phyogs thams cad khyab pas 'od kyi rwa ba chen po mchod rten gyi dbyibs can ngo bo rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyis bskor ba/ de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du māṃ ser po las mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga māṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las phag ser po bdun gyis bteg pa'i khri'i steng na/ rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can ma sku mdog ser mo/ sku skem pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la tsog 'dug gis langs pa la phyogs pa/ gcer bu/ phyag g.yas na khab/ g.yon na skud pa bsnams pa/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du māṃ ser po sogs nas rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai/ bstod pa/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar chad 'jigs pa kun las sgrol mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad pa// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal bstod// ༈ /lha mo dbyangs can ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang gu las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge doḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ thams cad lha mo dbyangs can mar gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus doḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba la doḥs mtshan par gyur/ pad+ma sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gsum phyag drug pa/

dbus dmar g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na gri gug ral gri pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon gsum na bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ rin po che/ 'khor lo bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing dar gyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bzhengs nas bzhugs pa/ sku las mi shes pa'i mun pa sel ba'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du doḥdamar po/ de las 'od 'phros zhes pa nas/ gshin rje'i mthing ga zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ gshed kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ sa ra swa tī/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs 'ongs shing*// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// 'di bla med yin pas ye shes sems dpa' mi dbyung ba 'thad par sems so// ༈ /'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge ni/ stong pa'i ngang las siṃ las seng ge sngon mo ral pa dmar ser dang ldan pa nyal nas kha gyen du phyogs te gtso bo zhal la blta ba/ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge dhīḥdamar ser tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'jam dpal du byas/ 'od zer tshur 'dus dhīḥl thim pas ral gri'i yu ba la dhīḥs mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge sku mdog dmar ser/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhi 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar bzung nas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa/

zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon cung zad brkyang bas rgyal po rol pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor cog dang ldan pa/ lang tsho dar la bab pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar ser rab tu 'phro ba/ 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur pa'i thugs kar bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar ral gri sor bzhi pa'i yu ba la dhīḥs mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me dī pa mañdzu shrī muṃ hrīḥpradzñā dhā tu hrīḥdhīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī/ bstod pa ni/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// zhes sogs bya// ༈ /'jam dbyangs dkar po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ dkar po las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po dwangs shing bsil ba pad+ma dkar po'i drwa bas khebs pa/ mtha' ne'u seng gis bskor ba la glang po thal ka du ma dal gyis rgyu ba/ mtsho dbus su pam̐ ljang gu las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge a dkar po cig tu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod cing sems can gyi don mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas sems can gyi mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal ba/
lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/

'dir mchims kyi gzhung du sku de nyid la dmigs nas sngags bzla ba las/ ye shes dgug gzhug sogs bya bar ma bshad kyang*/ gzhan gyi rigs 'grer byed na/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥmatshan sngags ni/ oṃ ār+ya mañdzu shrī/bstod pa ni/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing*// rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga ldan pa// dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog sbyin ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs// blo gros ngan pa sreg mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ /dzam+bha la ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dzaṃ yig ser po/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal dzam+bha la sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i char rab tu 'bebs bzhin pa'i ne'u le bsnams pa/ sangs rgyas lnga'i cod pan can/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dzaṃ ser po zhes pa nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya dzam+bha la/ bstod pa ni/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// zhes sogs bya// ༈ /bgegs mthar byed ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ gi 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs nas thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bgegs mthar byed zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje'i 'phyar bas 'jigs par byed pa/ zhal rab tu gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kro dha rā dza bigh+nān+ta kṛ ta/ bstod pa ni/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// zhes sogs so// ༈ /stobs po che ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid srid pa'i khro bo stobs po che sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis dbyug pa dkar po dang rnga yab/ g.yon pa gnyis kyis phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba la sbrul gyis bcings pa/ yan lag rags shing dmar ba sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od kyi phreng ba can/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā ba la/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// khro bo'i skur bstan bdud bgegs sogs// 'joms pa'i stobs chen khyod la bstod// ces so// ༈ /'byung po 'dul byed ni/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dkar po las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs pa phyar stabs su 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis 'byung po 'dul byed kyi phyag rgya bcings pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ mig gsum pa/ lag pa bzhi pa/ g.yas ḍa ma ru dang gri gug g.yon thod pa dang rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris shing skra ser po thor tshugs can kha bub tu mnan pa/ ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ bhū ta ḍa ma ra/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ bstod pa ni/ lcang lo can gyi sogs sam/ dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog sogs so// ༈ /khro rgyal dme ba brtsegs pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dud kha/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dme ba brtsegs pa rab tu 'jigs pa/ bltas pa tsam gyis gdon thams cad skrag par byed pa/ grib dang mi gtsang ba rnams 'byer bar byed pa/ gtum po chen po drag shul can/ shin tu rngom pa/ sku mdog dud kha/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal dud kha/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ g.yon dang po na sdigs mdzub kyi rtse mo la pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na zhags pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi tha ma gnyis bsnol nas sdigs mdzub 'phyar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ yan lag thams cad la sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dud kha/ de las 'od 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ bhurku ma ma shā pra ṇā ya bhu rtsi bhu rki bi ma le uts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ uts+tshuṣ+ma kro dha rā dza bstod pa ni/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs so// ༈ /mi g.yo ba dkar po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum bgrad cing khro gnyer rab tu g.yo ba/ smin ma dang sma ra 'khyug cing dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul gyis bcings pa/

rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo dang g.yas cog pu'i mthil gdan la brten te bzhengs ma stabs su mdzad de ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dkar po/ de las zhes yig rnying dā na shī las mdzad par hūm̐ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsgoms nas/ de'i mdun du yang de kho na lta bu zhal tshur bstan par bsgoms nas sngags bzla ba las ma bshad/ 'dir gzhan gyi rigs 'grer btang ba'i dbang du byas tshe/ pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad phyis kyi bla ma rnams rnam snang bzhed kyang mi bskyod pa 'thad dam snyam/ kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ shukla tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa rā dza/ bstod pa rab dkar gangs ri'i mdog can brjid mdzes sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ral gri zhags pa 'dzin// pus gtsugs 'gying zhing sgeg pa'i cha lugs can// blo ster mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ /mi g.yo ba sngon po ni/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri nam mkhar 'phyar pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar zhing zlum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ yan lag thams cad sbrul rgyan dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/

sngags gong ltar dang*/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya a tsa la/ bstod pa ni/ khyod sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// bdud dpung 'joms phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas// sna tshogs dngos grub yid bzhin stsol mdzad pa'i// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ /pad+ma'i rigs kyi khro bo rta mgrin ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pas seng ldeng gi dbyug to nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu bgrad cing*/ zhal mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu rta skad 'byin pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na bzhugs nas gnod byed gdug pa can dang sdig sgrib thams cad sreg par byed pa/ de'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ ha ya grī wa/ bstod pa ni/ mtshan tsam gyis kyang bdud dpung 'joms pa'i lha// dus mtha'i me 'od dang 'grogs bye ru yi// lhun po mi bzad gar gyis rol pa lta'i// khro mchog rta mgrin dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal// zhes so// ༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lha mo gdugs dkar po can ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig dkar po/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar po can/ sku mdog dkar mo zla ba'i 'od can zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ cung zad khro zhing 'dzum pa/ phyag g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas mda'/ gsum pas lcags kyu/ g.yon dang pos sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas ral gri 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyis na bzas brgyan pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing lang tsho dar la babs pa/ 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus na zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags snying po ni/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bai ra bai ra/ badz+ra dha ra ṇi/ ban+dha ban+dha naṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa sitā ta pa tre/ bstod pa ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi mtshan mchog gtsug tor nas// legs par 'khrungs pa'i rmad byung lha mo ni// gzhan gyis mi thub gtsug tor gdugs dkar zhes// yongs su grags pa de la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces so// ༈ /phyag rdor mdo lugs dpa' bo gcig pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig tu gsal ba de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas phyag na rdo rjer gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rjer gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar bsgreng ba/

spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul dkar sngon gyis thod byas pa/ ser pos snyan cha/ dmar pos mgur chu/ dkar pos ske rags dang phyag gdub/ nag pos se ral kha dang zhabs gdub byas pa/ sku stod la dar sngon po dang seng ge'i pags pa gsol ba/ sku smad la stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ba spu'i rdo rje rnams las me 'bar ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong nas srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs kar mchod rten sngon po/ de'i bum pa'i nang du hūm̐ la rtsa sngags kyis bskor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ nī lam+bā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ bstod pa ni/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas sogs/ zhes so// ༈ /kha sar+pa ṇa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kha sar+pa ṇa sku mdog dkar po zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ khri snyan sā le'i pags pa phrag par bkal ba/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las zhes pa nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya lo ki shwa ra/ bstod pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs// ༈ /'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na ni/
stong pa'i ngang las sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid yi ge dhīḥlas

dhīḥlas 'di 'jam dpal dmar ser yin pas sems nas phyi ma dag gi yi ge 'gar dmar ser du bshad 'dug kyang rgya gzhung du bdud rtsi'i 'od zer gyi gzugs dag cing gsal ba'i dhīḥzhes 'byung ba dang lha'i sku mdog kyang ston ka'i zla ba tshes pa lta bu zhes sogs shes byed mang du bshad pas dmar ser du 'khrul par mi bya'o// ral gri'i yu ba la dhīḥs mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas na shes rab kyi ral gri dang g.yon pu sti bsnams pa/ rin po che'i sna lnga'i rgyan gyi cod pan byas shing lcang lo lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing na bza' dmar po dang ldan pa/ mdzes shing sgeg pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa 'khor bzhin pa la sor gcig tsam gyis ma reg par a las ral gri'i yu bar dhīḥs mtshan pa las rang 'dra'i gtso bo/ mdun du ra las nyi ma'i 'od/ rgyab tu pa las zla 'od/ g.yas su tsa las skra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i skra can ma rnams zhal phyag gtso bo dang mtshungs pa gtso bo'i thugs ka'i dhīḥde las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ sngags ni/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī/ bstod pa ni/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// zhes sogs bya// ༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi yum bsrung ba lnga ni/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su ri rab kyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/

dbus su praṃ ser po/ shar du māṃ ljang gu/ lhor hūm̐ dkar po/ nub tu maṃ nag po/ byang du shaṃ dmar po/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las lha mo lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid so sor 'brang ma sku mdog ser mo/ ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu ma/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na rim pa bzhin/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ thugs kar gdugs bsnams pa'o// g.yon rnams na gzhu/ rgyal mtshan/ rin po che'i chun po/ dgra s+t+wa/ dung bsnams pa/ sha 'gag nag po dang*/ stod g.yogs dmar pos brgyan pa/ skyil krung phyed pas 'gying zhing bzhugs pa/ lha'i rgyan dang gos thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar du rma bya chen mo sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ phyag g.yas rma bya'i mdongs dang g.yon mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ lhor stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rma bya'i mdongs dang g.yon mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ nub tu gsang sngags rjes 'dzin sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon pa gnyis dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ byang du bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon gnyis na dgra s+t+wa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas zhes pa nas/ so sor 'brang ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin la mi bskyod pa/ stong chen rab 'byams la rnam snang*/ rma bya chen mo la don grub/ bsil ba'i tshal la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi ma hā pra ti sa re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ ta ba re ba re bi shud+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ a mṛ te bi lo ki ni garba saṃ rak+ṣa ni ā kar+ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bi ma le bi pu le dza ya wa re dza ya wa ti ni a mṛ ta mṛ dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bha ra bha ra saṃ bha ra/ saṃ bha ra/ in+d+rā ya ba la bi sho dha ni ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ pañtsa rak+ṣa de wi sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhes sogs so// ༈ /nor rgyun ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ yig ser po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ lang tsho gzhon pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'bru'i snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bzas rnam par brgyan cing zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dpag tu med pa'i grogs mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du baṃ ser po zhes pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ ba su dha rā rat+na ni dha na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ba su dha rā/ bstod pa ni/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis myur stsol ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces so// ༈ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i mchod rten bang rim gsum pa gdugs char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum pa'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog gangs ri ltar dkar ba zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser/ g.yon sngo zhing*/ mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa bzhi na sna tshogs rdo rje/ pad+ma dkar po la gnas pa'i rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ mda'/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon bzhi na gzhu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya/ bum pa bzang po bsnams pa/ lha rdzas kyi na bzas stod g.yogs sogs sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba 'phro ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas phyogs su zla ba la gnas pa'i spyan ras gzigs dkar po g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon phyogs su nyi ma la phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon ut+pa la'i steng du rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang zhi ba'i nyams can/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ shar du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang du stobs po che sngon po rtse gsum 'dzin cing g.yon pa thams cad sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra gyen du brdzes shing*/ rin po che dang klu brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ pad+ma rdo rje'ang byung*/ dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i steng gi phyogs gnyis nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i bu gnyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs nas bcom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol ba/ gtso mo'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i bh+rūṃ yig dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros

rgya gzhung du gnas byin rlabs kyi tshe spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dpral bar trāṃ/ lte bar hrīḥbarla gnyis la aṃ as mtshan pa zhes 'byung ba ltar byas na legs shing mi nus na spyi 'gros kyang rung bar bzhed do// zhes pa nas gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ swā hā/ snying po'o// oṃ a mī te/ a mī tota bha wa/ a mī ta bi kran+te/ a mī ta gā te/ a mī te ga mi ni/ a mī te ā yurda te/ ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ phreng ba'i sngags so// mtshan sngags/ oṃ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya/ bstod pa ni/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /ces so// ༈ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi sems dpa' rgyal ba byams mgon ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maiṃ yig gser mdog de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun byams pa mgon po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas zhal mdog 'di ltar bod gzhung du bzhugs kyang rgya gzhung du nag po dang dkar po ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi zhal lo zhes pa 'thad par sems/ dmar/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas me tog dang bcas pa'i klu shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa'i sprin 'phro ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du maiṃ/

de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ maiṃ tri ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya mai tri/ bstod pa ni/ byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsregs// zhes sogs so// ༈ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gangs ri'i phung po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil nas gyes pa'i g.yas ngos su pad+ma dkar po dang*/ g.yon ngos su pad+ma dmar po'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti 'dzin pa/ zhal mchu dang phyag mthil dang zhabs mthil rnams dmar ba/ dbu skra phyed du 'khyil ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas spras pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du oṃ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradzñā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bu dhi war+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ pradzñā pā ra mi ta/ bstod pa ni/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab kyi pha rol phyin// zhes sogs so// ༈ /nor rgyun ma ni/ mngon rtogs gong gi nor rgyun ma bzhin la/ sngags ni/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dha na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa yang gong bzhin bya'o// ༈ /rdo rje rigs kyi yum khro gnyer can ma ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du bh+ṝṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid lha mo khro gnyer can ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas gnyis mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon gnyis dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ khro gnyer dpral bar bsdus pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang lha rdzas kyi gos kyis bklubs pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ṝṃ/ de las 'od 'phros zhes pa nas/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ bh+ṝṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ār+ya bh+ṝ ku ṭi/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yum gyur lha mo gser mdog can// zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs sel ma// khro gnyer can ma la phyag 'tshal// ༈ /rgyal po rnam thos sras ni/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje yi dam du bskyed nas/ tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bai yig las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten khams kyi dpal 'byor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa bsdus te bai la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang zhing dri ma med pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rin po che'i be con thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa dku la brten pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang bas sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster ba/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi byang phyogs lcang lo can nas rgyal po rnam thos sras spyan drangs par bsams la/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas mdun gyi de la bstim/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs la/ rat+na ma ku ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa māṃ zhes pas dbang bskur/ sngags ni/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇā ya hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/

oṃ bai shra wa ṇā/ bstod pa/ rgyal chen rnam thang thos sras nor mang ldan// margad lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*// zhes sogs so// ༈ /mgon po gri gug can ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hūm̐ yig mthing nag las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid dpal mgon po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ klu rigs lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pas sham thabs byas pa/ me dpung dmar nag 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas mi ro bkan pa la bzhugs pa/ thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i lte bar gnas pa'i hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la ha na ha na badz+re ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā la/ 'di bla med ltar ye shes pa mi dbyung zhing*/ gtor ma dang nang mchod bla med ltar byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma phul sngags shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na sogs sngags rings dang*/ nang mchod mtshan sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas 'bul/ bstod pa/ srin po'i gzugs kyi gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// zhes so// de ltar bshad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa de rnams kyi spyi'i 'gros thams cad ni gong gi thub pa'i dbang po ltar shes par bya'o// rjes gnang de dag dang sgrub thabs skor gyi yi ge mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i lung dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rje btsun byams pa/ 'phags pa thogs med/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen/ kun mkhyen blo gros brtan pa/ paṇa chen shān+ti pa/ slob dpon sa ra he ta/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ 'brom rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rngog lo tsā ba legs pa'i shes rab/ lo chen blo ldan shes rab/ gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ chab chos kyi seng ge/ gtsang nag thugs rje seng ge/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ dpang ston grub pa shes rab/ khu ston bsod nams mchog grub/ dpal 'bar chos rje dpal ldan don grub/ rtse sa dang las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ thel brag lcog thams cad mkhyen pa/ thon pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ shangs ri bo dge 'phel ba phyogs las rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ brag dgon spyan snga gzhon nu chos dpal bzang po/ 'khon ston rdo

pha bong kha pa rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol/ rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ thugs sras gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ rab 'byams chos rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ gnas lnga rig pa ngag dbang skal ldan 'dren pa rgya mtsho 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i 'bangs/ skyo mda' ba bsod nams dbang phyug mkhas btsun chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ des bdag ban+de tshul khrims rin chen la bka' drin chen pos stsal to// yang de dag 'ga' zhig la sgos kyi brgyud pa bzhugs pa ltar na/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgon pa ba/ spyan snga rin po che bya yul ba/ gyer sgom chen po/ sangs rgyas dbon/ dpal ldan gro mo che/ mchims nam mkha' grags man snga ma dang 'dra'o// gnas brtan bcu drug gi rjes gnang phyag mchod bcas kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ sems tsam rnam bden gyi paṇ+ḍi ta/ rngog byang chub 'byung gnas/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad ka ba/ se spyil bu ba/ lha spyil bu ba/ rgan mo lhas pa chen po/ gro mo che/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ mi 'khrugs pa'i nye brgyud lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ jo bo rje/ rnal 'byor pa chen po/ spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ bya yul ba/ mu sman pa char chen/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ yang na mchims nas/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra/ yi ge drug pa'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni bya yul ba yan mi 'khrugs pa dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas gnubs ye shes seng ge/ sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ 'dul 'dzin grags pa brtson 'grus/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra/ seng ge sgra'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ bya yul ba nas bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod dam brtag

mchims brtson seng*/ mchims don rgyal/ mchims blo gros brtan pa/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ dgon pa ba/ ka ma pa shes rab 'od/ lum pa ye shes byang chub/ chu mig pa shes rab grags pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man 'dra/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma dang 'od zer can ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni bcu gcig zhal bzhin no// dbyangs can ma dmar mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta su ma ti kīrti/ mar do chos kyi dbang phyug mchims nam mkha' grags man snga ma bzhin no// 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags yan spyi brgyud ltar las/ de nas zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man 'dra/ dzam+bha brgyud pa 'di mchims blo bzang grags pa nas spyi brgyud dang 'brel ba ma gtogs/ mchims nam mkha' grags nas min no gsung*/ la ser po'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ paṇ+ḍi ta mañdzu gho ṣa/ shī la tsan+d+ra/ bla ma grags rgyal ba/ rgyang ro paṇa chen/ mchims blo bzang grags pa man 'dra/ bgegs mthar byed/ stobs po che/ mi g.yo ba dkar sngon rnams kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni bcu gcig zhal ltar ro// mi g.yo ba dmigs skor gsum gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ chu mig pa nas/ rma shākya gzhon nu bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod dam snyam/ dpal ldan gro/ sgom pa seng ge skyabs/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ gdugs dkar gyi 'di gro ston nas brgyud pa 'dren pa las/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi brgyud pa ni min no gsung*/ brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ a bha yā ka ra/ kīrti tsan+d+ra/ lo tsā ba grags pa rgyal mtshan/

rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma gzhon nu/ dka' bcu pa/ gro ston kun dga' rgyal mtshan man 'dra/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma cha lnga pa'i lung gi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo nas/ 'brom ston pa/ po to pa/ ram sdings pa/ ldan shes rab grags/ slob dpon chu nag pa rin chen seng ge/ ra zab dar ma rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis ka las mchims nam mkha' grags man sngar bzhin no// rjen gtor gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ jo bo rje nas/ nag tsho lo tsā ba/ dge bshes phyag sor ba/ zhu ldan pa/ dpal ldan gro/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags man 'dra/ nor rgyun ma'i brgyud pa lugs gcig na dzam+bha la dang 'dra/ shes phyin dkar mo dang khro gnyer can ser mo'i brgyud pa lugs gcig ni bcu gcig zhal dang 'dra/ rnam thos sras kyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po/ 'gro bzang snying po/ kha che rin chen rdo rje/ kha che dgon pa ba/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba bar 'dir bla ma gzhan yod med brtag byar yod/ chu mig pa/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston smon lam tshul khrims man sngar bzhin no// mgon po gri gug can gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ bram ze mchog sred/ dzi na mi tra/ shān+ti pa/ jo bo rje/ dge bshes ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ mu sman pa char chen/ gro ston bdud rtsi grags/ zhang ston chos kyi bla ma/ mchims nam mkha' grags/ skyo ston man 'dra/ dbyangs can ma dmar mo mar do dang dā na shī la'i rang 'gyur gyi mi g.yo ba sogs mchims kyis gsan pas brgyud pa so sor 'byung ba ma gtogs brgyud pa de min pa jo bo nas brgyud pa med dam snyam pa'i 'khrul gzhi gzung bar mi bya ste brgyud tshul tha dad gzhan yang mchis pas so// smras pa/ mchog gi lhas bskos min pas thob dka' zhing*// thob rnams ci 'dod 'bras bu rtag 'jo ba// dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ya mtshan rjes dran pas// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam sgrub skor byas// nan ltar 'bad pa spyi brtol ya ma brla// ma yin rdo rje theg pa'i zab chos skor// bar med brgyud pa phreng rgyud mkhan ma'i zong*// min no byin rlabs drod ldan dam pa'i chos// brjod bya mi dman 'phags yul mkhas pa'i gzhung*// brjod tshul ma 'brel 'gal ngad zlos pas dben// brjod pa'i dgos pa mi gsal gsal phye bas// brjod don snying po blangs 'dir nongs pa ci// a ti shar brgyud gdams pa'i sgrub thabs dang*// rjes su gnang bstar mchims chen mkhas pa'i dbang*// sā la'i ljongs su slar yang son to zhes// blo ldan 'ga' zhig rab dga'i gar gyis brel// rnam dkar legs byas khyung sngon skyes de yis// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i nyi ma 'dzam gling mkhar// rnam mang lus can dpal du brtan byed cing*// rnam grol phyogs kyi snang ba rgyas gyur cig

/ces mnyam med jo bo chen po rje nas brgyud pa'i gdams ngag thor bu ba rnams dpal snar thang mkhan po chen po mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa las rjes su gnang ba yod pa rnams zur du bkar ba'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i ba mo zhes bya ba 'di ni gtso bor mchims nam mkha' grags kyis bsgrigs pa'i rgya gzhung gtso che'i yi ge gzhir byas/ gzhan yang skyid shod zhabs drung dang ma ṇi ba sogs kyis mdzad pa'i bod gzhung dang*/ bla ma chos kyi rje dam pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa'i phyag bzhes bcas pa la legs par gtugs nas nyams su blang bde bar rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed du bod pa'i gnam lor sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
